summary: Recraftr iteration 2 - full backend + frontend verification. 28/28 pytest pass (17 legacy + 11 new for streaming/cover-letter/library/compare). Real LLM streaming confirmed: analyze-stream, optimize-stream, and cover-letter-stream all emit >=3 delta events spread over time (>50ms first-to-last), then a final done event with valid schema and DB persistence. Frontend stream-preview textContent grew across polls (31 -> 179 -> 1034 -> 1707 -> 2381 -> 2887 -> 3304 -> 3798 chars) so users actually see live tokens. Cover-letter generated real personalized content (1817 chars, mentions React/TypeScript/Acme Corp from resume), Cover-letter PDF download triggered a real 2862-byte file starting with %PDF. Compare page returns 2 rows sorted by ATS desc (88, 86) with full breakdown/keywords/skills/experience columns. Skills loaded: ai-testing-core, ai-testing-llm.

issues: Resume library can grow unbounded (had 29 items after previous testing). The GET /api/resumes .to_list(50) caps it at 50 in the response but the UI has no pagination, no search, no dedupe (same filename repeated). Consider dedup-by-filename hint or a search box for users with many versions.

The <label> wrapping <Checkbox> plus its own onCheckedChange fires the Radix checkbox reliably from mouse clicks but a Playwright/JS click on the outer <label> does NOT toggle it (label click hits the inner Checkbox button via native <label htmlFor> only when linked). Not a real user bug but affects automation. Fine as-is.

action_items: (Optional) UX polish on /compare: dedupe or search when library >10 items; the demo user had 29 resumes accumulating.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: SSE endpoints use a clean generator pattern; StreamingResponse with X-Accel-Buffering: no + Cache-Control: no-cache is correct for ingress proxies.

ai_service._run_stream: fallback to send_message if stream_message raises is smart, but note the fallback yields ONE big delta (buf as a single chunk), so 'streaming' silently degrades to non-streaming without telling the client. Consider surfacing this (e.g., yield type:info) so the UI can adapt.
/api/compare runs analyses SEQUENTIALLY (one asyncio await per resume). For 5 resumes with a slow LLM this stacks 5x latency. Consider asyncio.gather with a small semaphore to parallelize.
/api/resumes has no server-side pagination and .to_list(50) silently truncates - fine for now but flag if library grows.
pdf_generator.build_cover_letter_pdf produces a valid PDF and layout is different from resume (as required).
Frontend stream.js parser handles multi-chunk decode correctly; no memory-leak in the buf trimming.
test_credentials: Demo user: test@resumematch.ai / testpass123 (verified working). File: /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Sample resume at /tmp/sample_resume.pdf. Excess demo-user resumes trimmed from 29 to 3 to keep the Compare page tidy.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SSE endpoints are all behind Bearer auth and return text/event-stream. To assert incremental streaming, capture timestamps of each 'delta' event and require first_last_gap > 50ms; a single 'delta' chunk means the ai_service fallback path fired (stream_message failed). loadscope + xdist -n 2: keep tests that share pytest module-level state (e.g. pytest.stream_analysis_id) inside the SAME class so they land on one worker. Backend log path: /var/log/supervisor/backend*.log (no LLM errors observed during this run).
feature_verdicts: POST /api/analyze-stream (GPT 5.4 SSE) - pass - evidence: content-type text/event-stream, 3+ delta events with time-gap >50ms (measured in test_1_analyze_stream), done event carries analysis_id + ats_score int + breakdown ints + gap_analysis list + missing_skills dict; persistence verified via GET /history/{id}. UI: stream-preview grew 31->3798 chars over 8 polls, final ATS=78 rendered in ring.

POST /api/optimize-stream (GPT 5.4 SSE) - pass - evidence: SSE headers correct, deltas>=3, done.result.optimized_resume >200 chars with SUMMARY/SKILLS/EXPERIENCE headers, predicted_ats_score int, original_resume_text present, DB updated with optimization + optimized_at.

POST /api/cover-letter-stream (GPT 5.4 SSE) - pass - evidence: SSE headers, deltas>=3, final cover_letter string >150 chars real personalized content. UI: 1817-char letter opening 'Building fast, accessible React products at scale has been the focus of my work for the past seven years...' mentioning Acme Corp (from the uploaded resume - no fabrication).
POST /api/cover-letter-pdf - pass - evidence: 2862 bytes returned, Content-Type application/pdf, first 4 bytes %PDF. UI download triggered a real file.
GET /api/resumes - pass - evidence: items array (id, filename, created_at), no _id leak, no text leak.
DELETE /api/resumes/{id} - pass - evidence: 200 first time, 404 on repeat.

POST /api/compare - pass - evidence: rejects <30 char JD with 400, rejects >5 resumes with 400, happy path returned 2 results sorted by ats_score desc (88, 86) with breakdown/missing_skills/top_improvements. UI table rendered rows correctly with 'Best fit' label.
Non-streaming /api/analyze /api/optimize /api/download-pdf /api/history* /api/auth* - pass - evidence: legacy TestAuth/TestResumeUpload/TestAnalyzeOptimizeLLM/TestHistory/TestPdfDownload all green.
Frontend brand 'Recraftr' - pass - evidence: <title>Recraftr - AI Resume Optimizer</title>, AppHeader shows 'Recraftr', Login/Signup show 'Recraftr'.
Frontend Compare nav from header - pass - evidence: [app-header-compare] navigates to /compare and resume library loads.
